faqs.q: Sec. 78-9. - Provisional order method; contents of resolution generally.
faqs.a:
Whenever the council shall be of the opinion that the interest of the city requires
               any project, the council, by resolution, shall direct the engineer to prepare:
(1)
Preliminary plans showing:
a.
A typical section of the contemplated project; and
b.
The type of material, approximate thickness and width;
(2)
A preliminary estimate of the cost of the project, including incidental costs; and
(3)
An assessment plat showing the:
a.
Area to be assessed; and
b.
Amount of maximum benefits estimated to be assessed against each tract in said assessment
                  area.
(Code 1981, § 27-10; Ord. No. 551, § 8(A), 5-14-1964)
